records.topic: Prohibition of corruption after restoration; fear and hope in prayer

records.topic: Winds, rain-bearing clouds, revived barren earth as resurrection analogy

candidates.similarity: God waters earth and causes vegetation to grow
candidates.difference: Psalm celebrates provision; Qur'an adds wind/cloud sequence and explicitly uses revivification as resurrection analogy
